## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `7bcb29c20a13387333bbef532a003b4a8974b093`
Local-runs: none

PR #37421 for card #37290. Read: the card body and its four comments (triage 7163981674 and 7167139627, claim 7180634038, dev report 7181920218; no ruling and no earlier record on the card), the PR body, the three-file net diff against `origin/main`, the 51 check-runs on this head, and the cited source on the head (`relatedParentScope.ts`, `parent-scope.ts`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`, `AppContent.tsx`). Nothing built or run.

Face: no published schema and no governed path in the three files (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success), and the `Clause-②:` line is a bare `no` with no narrowing arm, so the declaration face is what remains and `TIER_DEFAULT` is the exact tier.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Public exports: none added, none changed. Right.** `relatedCreateSeedOf` is already exported at `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/core.ts:51` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` is already a dependency of `@object-ui/app-shell`; `parentRelationshipFieldDef` is already exported from `@object-ui/core`. The diff adds two imports and no export. The card's "seeds through the same `relatedCreateSeedOf`" is met by the one function, not a copy.
- **URL accept set (`formLink`): not widened. Right.** The repeated `formLink` pair, parent first, is the shape `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.openChildForm` writes (lines 484 to 491) and `AppContent` already parses (lines 865 to 882, first pair per field wins). `sp.set` became `sp.delete` plus `sp.append`, which is the same URL for the single-pair case, so a lookup with no `dependsOn` writes what it wrote on main.
- **Seed rule: the helper's own, unchanged. Right.** A lookup or master_detail, single-valued, each `dependsOn` entry resolved from the parent, text values only, the link field itself skipped, and nothing seeded when one entry does not resolve. The page adds no rule of its own to what is seeded.
- **New observable behaviour: one `findOne(source.o, source.i)` on the New click, and the form now opens after that read settles. Right in intent, with one gap, S1.** The read is gated on a non-empty `dependsOn` array on the link's field def; null, a non-object and a rejected read all fall back to the parent pair alone, as the PR body and the changeset say.
- **What a metadata author can write: unchanged. Right.** `dependsOn` keeps the meaning #37246 gave it on the related tab; this entry now honours it too. `Metadata-protocol: none` stands.

Findings:

- S1 (should-fix) — the New click is now asynchronous with no in-flight state and no staleness guard (`ObjectDataPage.tsx`, the `findOne` branch of the New button's `onClick`). Three consequences. The button stays enabled and draws nothing while the read is pending, so on a slow link the click looks dead. A read that never settles never opens the form: the fallback covers a rejected or empty read, not a hung one. And `open` applies `sp`, a copy of the search params taken at click time, through the click-time `setSearchParams`: a filter change or a navigation made while the read is pending is overwritten or undone when it resolves, where on main the write was synchronous and could not be stale (the related tab's writer reads `window.location.search` live). Narrow window, nothing is written to data, so not a blocker. Fix shape: disable or mark the button while pending, and drop the result when the location or the mount has changed since the click.
- S2 (should-fix) — the fallback the changeset publishes ("a parent that cannot be read opens with the parent link alone") has no pin. The two cases cover the seeded read and the no-`dependsOn` control; the `.catch` arm and the null arm are untested. One case with `findOne` rejecting closes it.
- N1 (nit) — the read fetches the whole parent record where the `dependsOn` params are all it uses; `QueryParams.$select` exists (`ui/packages/types/src/data.ts:72`). The page also re-reads `dependsOn` itself to decide whether to fetch, a second copy of a gate the helper owns. A small export beside `relatedCreateSeedOf` that names the params would serve both the gate and the projection.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/37290-view-all-new-dependson-seed.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/console` patch. **Matches.** The diff moves `ui/packages/app-shell` alone (one source file, one test file); it is a bug fix in a released package, so patch. `@object-ui/console` ships the pre-built SPA built on app-shell (`workspace:*`), and naming it beside app-shell is the repo's standing practice for a console-visible fix. `Check Changeset` success.
- Clause-②: `no` — right. No accept set is widened or narrowed: no spec key, no export, no new URL parameter or value shape, no accepted input that main refused. The line is line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, same spelling on both, and carries no arm, which is correct for a change that neither widens nor narrows.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — right, and `none` takes patch, which is the level shipped.
- Not breaking: no banner, no migration and no ADR-0087 disposition owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. `security_findings`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: none. Nothing to escalate.
- Deviation, the client closure built locally so the app-shell test could resolve `@objectstack/client`: accepted. A local build; the diff carries three files and no built output.
- Deviation, app-shell type-check and two derived families (`check:type-check-debt`, the `ui` `scripts/` vitest run) not measured locally because a sibling held the verify lock: **accepted.** The check-runs on this head are the gate verdicts: `Type Check UI` success, `Type Check · debt ledger` success, `Type Check · workspace` success, `Test UI` success (aggregate, with shards 1 to 9), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success. The diff also touches no file under `ui/scripts`. The dev named the gap instead of reporting a green it did not measure, which is the right shape.
- Deviation, `origin/main` merged once before opening: accepted. Head `7bcb29c2` is that merge over `ad4ceb57`; the merge changes none of the three PR files nor the two helpers they call, so the red and green legs quoted at `ad4ceb57` describe this head's code, and `Test UI` on the head governs in any case.
- File surface against the claim (7180634038): held. `ObjectDataPage.tsx` in the record-trail New path only, one pin file named for the card, one changeset; `relatedParentScope.ts` read, not changed.
- Acceptance: both items met. The pin is two cases, with the red reading quoted in the PR body and the dev report.
- **SQL push-down: no finding.** The change adds no id materialisation and no in-app join: one read of one row by primary key, with nothing fanned out from its result. The read is justified. The related tab seeds from the parent record its page already holds; this page holds the trail entry only (object, id, title), and the `dependsOn` values live on the parent row, so they must come from somewhere. Carrying them in the trail would put record data in every "View all" URL for a click most visits never make, and no server-side seed exists to push to. The read is lazy (on the click, not on mount), gated (only when the link declares a `dependsOn`, pinned by the control case), single, and it goes through the same permission-enforced `findOne` door as any record read, so a user who cannot read the parent gets the parent pair alone. The unprojected column list is N1, a nit.

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `7bcb29c20a13387333bbef532a003b4a8974b093`
**REWORK** — L1, seat repo:objectstack#5: the two should-fix findings of contract record 7182025259 are fixed in this PR before landing; the rest of L1 reads clean.

1. **Shape**: open draft against `main`, 3 files (+199/−3), `Fixes #37290`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch changeset on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`. `l1-face` is CLEAN: 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed.
2. **Premise**: the record finds the seed reuses `relatedCreateSeedOf` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail/core` (already exported, not copied), the `formLink` URL shape is the one the related tab writes, and the single permission-enforced `findOne` of the parent is justified: lazy, on click, only when the lookup declares `dependsOn`. No SQL push-down finding.
3. **Owed in this PR**:
   - **S1.** The New click is now asynchronous with no in-flight state and no staleness guard. Nothing shows while the parent read is pending, a read that never settles never opens the form, and the resolve writes search params copied at click time, so a filter change or navigation made meanwhile is overwritten. Give it a pending state (disable the button or ignore repeat clicks), bound the wait so the form opens with the parent link alone when the read does not settle, and drop the result if the page moved on.
   - **S2.** The changeset publishes "a parent that cannot be read opens with the parent link alone", but the rejected and null read arms have no pin. Add them, and pin the S1 timeout or staleness arm too.
   The same reviewer reads the delta.
4. **Accepted deviations**: the type-check and two derived families not measured locally (sibling held the verify lock); the head's `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · workspace` and `Test UI` runs are green, and nothing under `ui/scripts` changed. Nit N1 (`$select` the `dependsOn` params instead of the whole row; the page re-checks `dependsOn` the helper already gates) is fixed in the same push if cheap.
5. **Out of scope and where it went**: none.
6. **Landing terms**: ungoverned, default tier. A same-head PASS with S1 and S2 closed and an **ACCEPT** are owed. The area lands it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `90c47a7a633aab768f585c42cef6dc0ec079a06b`
Local-runs: none

Delta review of PR #37421 (card #37290), rework round 1, against record 7182025259 on head `7bcb29c2`. Read: the delta `7bcb29c2..90c47a7a` (three commits, the same three files, +107/−12, no merge of main), dev report 7183408462, seat verdict 7182035521, the PR body as it stands, the 51 check-runs on this head (38 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed), and the cited source on the head. Nothing built or run. Face unchanged: no schema, no governed path, a bare `Clause-②: no`, so the declaration face and `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- S1: closed. Each of the four claims holds in the code (`ObjectDataPage.tsx`, the New button's `onClick`).
  - Pending state: `disabled={createDisabled || newPending}` and `aria-busy` while the read runs. Right.
  - Bound: the read is raced against `TRAIL_NEW_PARENT_READ_TIMEOUT_MS` (5000); past it `open(undefined)` writes the parent pair alone. A read that answers after the bound is ignored, since the race has settled, so the form cannot open twice. Right.
  - Stale drop: a per-mount click token, bumped by an unmount cleanup, and a compare of pathname plus search at click time against the live `locationRef`. Right.
  - Synchronous throw: `findOne` is now called inside a `then`, so a throw lands in the same `.catch` as a rejection. Right.
- What I looked for in the rework and did not find:
  - The timer is cleared whenever the race settles. After an unmount it lives at most 5 s, then fires into the token check and sets nothing.
  - A read that never settles is held only by the data source; the page keeps no reference past the race.
  - `newPending` is restored on every path of a live mount: the stale-address path clears it before returning, and the only path that skips it is a superseded or unmounted click.
  - A hash-only change is not read as stale, since the compare is pathname plus search, so it cannot misfire there.
  - The three new hooks sit above the first early return (the `objectDef` guard), and `Lint UI` is green.
- S2: closed. Four new cases: refused, empty, hung (fake timers, also asserts `disabled` and `aria-busy`), stale (asserts the moved address survives and no `formLink` is written). The dev reports ablations turning hung, stale and refused red, and says plainly that the empty case pins a promise and not a guard, which is correct: `relatedCreateSeedOf` answers `{}` for a missing parent. `Test UI` is green on this head.
- N1: open, not taken, reason accepted. Narrowing the read to the `dependsOn` params needs the helper's parsing, which means a new export on the published `@object-ui/plugin-detail/core`: a widening outside this card's claimed surface. It stays a nit and blocks nothing.
- **New export `TRAIL_NEW_PARENT_READ_TIMEOUT_MS`: not a public-surface change. Right.** It is exported from the `ObjectDataPage` module for the test to import. That module reaches the package only through `AppContent`'s lazy import, and the package's one published entry does not re-export it.
- N2 (nit) — the PR body's Tests section still says "two cases"; the file now holds six. Nothing else in the body is false: "A failed or empty read opens with the parent pair alone" and "no export change" both still hold, and the quoted red and green legs are labelled with the head they were read on. The body is silent on the pending state, the bound and the stale drop, which the changeset and comment 7183408462 state. The body should be patched when the relay allows it.
- N3 (nit) — a dropped stale result opens nothing and shows nothing. That is the behaviour the changeset declares, so it is a noted trade-off, not a defect.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset unchanged in level: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch. **Still matches.** The rework stays inside app-shell. `Check Changeset` success.
- The changeset body now states the pending state, the 5-second bound and the stale drop, each matching the code.
- Clause-②: `no` — still right. Nothing accepted is widened or narrowed, and the new constant is not on a published entry. Same spelling in the PR body and the changeset.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — still right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. `security_findings`: none. Nothing to escalate.
- Deviation, PR body not patched because the relay refused it: accepted for this round. One sentence in the body is now out of date (N2); no behaviour claim in it is false.
- Deviation, worktree re-created and two closures rebuilt locally: accepted. The delta carries the same three files and no built output.
- Deviation, app-shell type-check and two derived families not measured locally: accepted as before. `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · workspace` and `Test UI` are success on this head, and no file under `ui/scripts` changed.
- File surface against the claim: held. The same three files.
- **SQL push-down: no finding, unchanged.** The rework adds no read. It is still one row by primary key, on the click, only when the link declares a `dependsOn`, through the permission-enforced `findOne`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37290-view-all-new-seed`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X`

**VERDICT: PASS**
